title: EdgeKeeper Sheath Makes Carbon Steel Knife Special
text:
EdgeKeeper Sheath Makes Carbon Steel Knife Special. It’s the “EdgeKeeper” sheath that makes this FARBERWARE 5252819 EDGEKEEPER BUTCHER KNIFE (7-Inch, Black) special. The sheath sharpens the blade every time that you insert or withdraw the knife, so there’s no need to mess with a sharpening steel to keep a good edge on the knife.

The knife itself is made of carbon steel, and has a hard plastic handle. It’s a decent knife, reasonably well balanced, and comfortable to hold. The edge is sharp, thanks to the EdgeKeeper sheath. However, the knife doesn't hold the edge well as you use it, so you need the sharpening sheath.

The knife is strictly hand-washable (use warm, soapy water). Wipe the blade dry immediately after washing, before replacing the knife in the sheath.
